//: Every external dependency, why we have it and where it may be used (plan 7.1). Adding one needs Liam's approval. A package may use it when its name matches allowedIn (* matches any text) and its layer is in layers. See docs/guides/dependencies.md.

@biomejs/biome.reason: Formatter and linter in one fast tool.

@types/node.reason: Type definitions for Node, for Node packages, tests and tooling. Every package's tsconfig.test.json loads them; core, host and Studio sources load no Node types (their tsconfig sets types: [] and the layers rule rejects /// <reference types> there).

@typescript/typescript6.reason: The TypeScript parser API for tooling/check until TypeScript 7.1 ships its own API (D9). Remove then.

turbo.reason: Per-package tasks, --affected and the build cache (D9).
